description: json.get gives a string's decoded value, a number as written, and true or false as text, and none for null or an absent path.
program: (let [doc "{\"name\": \"demo\", \"version\": \"1.40\", \"count\": 12, \"ratio\": 1.50, \"big\": 123456789012345678901234567890, \"on\": true, \"off\": false, \"none\": null, \"tags\": [\"a\", \"b\"], \"esc\": \"q\\\"é\\n\"}"] [(json.get doc ["name"]) (json.get doc ["count"]) (json.get doc ["ratio"]) (json.get doc ["big"]) (json.get doc ["on"]) (json.get doc ["off"]) (json.get doc ["none"]) (json.get doc ["gone"]) (json.get doc ["tags" "1"]) (json.get doc ["tags" "2"]) (json.get doc ["esc"])])
